contract.return: individual focal reward full continuation, no bootstrap/V/learned-Q tail
contract.branch: teammates use anchor BC argmax for first step; only focal action 0..8 is forced; all agents use BC argmax from t+1

action_mapping.ordering: [(a,w) for a in (-0.4,0,0.4) for w in (-pi/6,0,pi/6)]

seed_manifest.seed_policy: fresh fixed natural canonical-BC argmax rollout; no noise/exploration

empirical_return_noise.method: repeat same frozen snapshot/action twice before critic inference

margin_filter.selection: absolute empirical alternative-vs-BC return difference > fixed tolerance

ac4a_to_ac4b.interpretation_rule: positive direction requires overall Spearman > 0, raw BC sign accuracy > 0.5, and filtered sign accuracy > 0.5 when defined
